 Synopsis
 The investor also sold rights entitlements to subscribe to an additional 1.12 crore shares, according to a disclosure filed with the stock exchanges. Ola Electric is in the process of raising Rs 1,000 crore through a rights issue of partly paid-up equity shares. SVF II Ostrich (DE) LLC, an investment vehicle of the Japanese SoftBank Group, has sold 5.55 crore equity shares of Ola Electric Mobility, representing 1.2% of the company’s share capital, through open-market transactions between January 6 and October 22 this year.The investor also sold rights entitlements to subscribe to an additional 1.12 crore shares, according to a disclosure filed with the stock exchanges.
